[state-coverage-b] Audited 17 panels across Work/Context/Activity/Labs/Mills surfaces.

Strong adopters of the canonical EmptyState/PanelShell/error-banner pattern: BacklogPanel, EvalPanel, PipelinesPanel, AuditPanel, CrossRepoCard, PolicyProposalsCard, SquadsPanel (mostly), Mills OverviewPanel, CatalogPanel, SpawnList — all distinguish disabled/error/empty branches with hints and (for the Mills set) keyboard-accessible rows.

Recurring weakness across the rest of the surface: error states are tracked in the store but never rendered in the panel (ContextHealth, Memory, Reasoning, Stream, Timeline), or rendered as low-affordance text without retry actions (Workflows, Knowledge). Empty states often conflate "first-load in progress" with "truly empty" because the loading guard is missing (Memory, Reasoning). The SpawnTelemetry tabs all roll their own bare-text empties/errors instead of using the shared EmptyState component.

The most load-bearing systemic finding is `shuttle-weaver-emptystate-wrong-prop` — 4 sites pass `message=` to a component whose only prop is `heading=`, so the bundle ships the right strings but never renders them, leaving the user with the default "No data yet" on Shuttle's Agent Capacity / Dispatch Recommendations and Weaver's Domains / Recent Queries. This is the same shape as the FleetTable :global() scope-drop trap: the developer wrote code that "looks right" but the consumer/component prop contracts mismatch silently.

The other systemic finding is `no-focus-visible-on-clickable-rows-and-tabs` — bundle scan shows only 6 components ship `:focus-visible` styles (data-table-wrap, DataTable tr.clickable, unseen-indicator, spawn-row, metric-card.clickable, session-row-button).
